features.title: Guardian of the wild
features.text: Druids channel the primal magic of nature, calling storms, commanding plants, befriending beasts or changing shape.

features.title: Druidic order
features.text: The order sets the druid's signature focus spell and style, from a loyal animal companion to turning into a monster mid-fight.
